# Version 4.153.0
> **Skia m153 rendering reliability** · Released September 21, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.153.0) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.153.0)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.153.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1.300/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.153.0 updates to Skia m153 with font-selection and GPU reliability changes. Native HarfBuzz remains 14.2.1; the .300 package revision distinguishes the m153 line rather than a new shaping-engine release.

## Breaking Changes

- **Pin fonts when exact Linux fallback matters** — Linux fontconfig fallback now tries FcFontMatch before the previous FcFontSort path. The selected face, glyphs, or text metrics may differ. Use an explicit family/style or a bundled typeface when deterministic selection matters. ([#4826](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4826))

## Engine

- **Skia milestone m153** — Updates the bundled renderer to m153 without changing the managed API or C ABI. A servicing correction also releases the SkCachedData mutex guard before deleting the object. ([#4826](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4826), [#4927](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4927))

## Bug Fixes

- **Glyph-atlas and flush correctness** — Prevents partial glyph-vector updates from validating stale atlas locations and propagates native Ganesh task, flush, and submission failures. Existing C and managed flush methods remain void. ([#5062](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5062))
- **Failed GPU uploads no longer feed stale draws** — Ganesh checks failed buffer uploads and initialization under memory pressure instead of drawing stale contents. Triangulated paths retain CPU vertex data for a later upload attempt. ([#5116](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5116))
- **Windows HarfBuzz binaries pass BA2007** — Corrects the compiler-warning configuration that caused BinSkim BA2007 failures in applications consuming HarfBuzzSharp.NativeAssets.Win32. Native exports and shaping behavior are unchanged; other existing BinSkim warnings are unaffected. ([#5120](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5120))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1.300

Windows native assets now pass BinSkim BA2007 after correcting how vendored-source warnings are suppressed. The native engine remains HarfBuzz 14.2.1, with unchanged exports and shaping behavior.

## Release Candidate 1 (September 6, 2026)

Release Candidate 1 carried release infrastructure updates; its collected PR adds no new consumer API or rendering behavior.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/compare/v4.153.0-preview.1.26454.6...v4.153.0-rc.1.26456.2)

## Preview 1 (September 3, 2026)

Preview 1 updated to Skia m153, including the Linux fontconfig fallback change and a SkCachedData lifetime correction. HarfBuzzSharp moved to the .300 package revision bucket without changing native HarfBuzz 14.2.1.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/compare/v4.152.3...v4.153.0-preview.1.26454.6)
